data.name: Open Energy Data Layer — Philippine Electricity Rates Data API
data.description: Static, read-only JSON API over the DOE Electricity Rates & Power Market Monitor workbook: monthly average rates for residential, commercial, industrial and blended generation-charge customers across 141 distribution utilities and electric cooperatives in 18 PSGC regions, 2018-01 to 2026-10 (latest published month). It also publishes the provider service-area coverage layer (which LGUs/barangays each utility serves, with per-row source provenance). Every response states its source, licence status and disclaimers; NDA, missing and invalid source cells are preserved as explicit states and never imputed.

notes: The DOE page embeds a public Google Sheet (four tabs: residential, commercial, industrial, generation). Every tab was exported as CSV; the per-tab SHA-256 above is the exact bytes retrieved and kept under data/raw/doe-rates/.
The source workbook has no stable dataset identifier or documented refresh calendar; this snapshot is one dated retrieval, not a live feed.
The source workbook contains no explicit licence. The DOE site footer says content is in the public domain unless otherwise stated; reuse terms are to be confirmed with DOE in writing.

identifiers.utility: utility_code — the stable slug used by this dataset (e.g. MERALCO), not an official DOE/ERC id.
identifiers.region: region_psgc — 10-digit PSA PSGC region code (e.g. 1300000000 for NCR).
identifiers.month: YYYY-MM billing month, as labelled in the source workbook.

status_vocabulary.published: The source workbook has a numeric rate for this utility, class and month.
status_vocabulary.nda: "No Data Available" as published by the source (an explicit NDA cell), never zero.
status_vocabulary.missing: The month column exists in the source but this cell is blank / not yet published.
status_vocabulary.invalid: A cell that failed extraction validation; no value is published for it.

notes: Coverage rows are published verbatim in data/seed/service_areas.csv: utility_code, source_id, area_level, the PSGC hierarchy and a coverage_note. Every utility has at least one row.
A row is a published franchise/service area, not verified household-level billing territory. Region-level rows are an explicit fallback, not LGU-level confirmation.

Multi-region utilities in this snapshot: AURELCO, BASELCO, CAGELCO-II, FIBECO, LASURECO, MERALCO, PPALMA, QUEZELCO-I, SUKELCO, ZAMSURECO-I. MERALCO is the documented franchise-law case: RA 12146 Section 1 enumerates its LGUs in NCR, Region III and Region IV-A plus 17 Pampanga barangays, while the DOE workbook lists MERALCO under NCR only.

Coverage sources carry their own licences (public law, CC BY-SA where the OpenStreetMap Wiki / Wikipedia tables are used, DOE terms unconfirmed for the region fallback); see service_area.sources and /v1/sources.json.

not_included: Power-plant points: data/seed/plants.csv is illustrative sample data and is not part of this API.
Bill-component breakdown (generation, transmission, system loss, distribution, subsidies, FIT-All, taxes): not in the DOE workbook and not published here.
No imputed, interpolated or modelled values are published; an absent value stays absent.

Service-area coverage is derived data, not part of the DOE rates publication: a franchise area is not verified billing territory, and region-level rows are a fallback. See service_area and /v1/service-areas.json for provenance and licences.
notes: This is a static snapshot: files are JSON documents and there is no query layer, so next_cursor is always null and there are no filter parameters.
api_version is the JSON contract version; dataset_version changes with each new retrieval of the source workbook.
Coverage counts (utilities_with_lgu_coverage, rows per area level) are derived from the coverage seed and re-checked at build time; the API never hardcodes them.
